how_to_apply: Open the link given on the Karnataka Examinations Authority website, https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/, between 18 November 2026 and 15 December 2026.
Fill in the online application for the Assistant Public Prosecutor-cum-Assistant Government Pleader post.
Enter the correct RD number of your caste/reservation certificate where reservation is claimed.
Upload a recent passport-size photograph in JPEG format with a white background, between 50KB and 200KB.
Upload your signature, made with a black ink sketch or marker pen on white paper, scanned in JPEG format between 50KB and 70KB. Applications without a photograph and signature are rejected.
Pay the fee online by 16 December 2026.
Submit the application; no information can be changed or corrected at any stage after submission.
Aadhaar card
Marks cards of each year of the law degree
Advocate practice certificate from the competent authority and Bar Association service certificate
Reservation certificate in the prescribed form with RD number: Form 'D' for SC (Category A, B, C) and ST, Form 'E' for Category-1, Form 'F' for Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B
Rural candidate certificates (Form-1 from the Tahsildar with RD number; Form-2 signed by the school headmaster and countersigned by the Block Education Officer)
Kannada medium certificate (Classes 1 to 10), signed and sealed by the school headmaster
Disability certificate or UDID certificate from the prescribed medical authority
Third gender certificate from the District Magistrate under the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019
Sports achievement certificate from the relevant authority (sportsperson reservation)
Ex-servicemen: release certificate, or No Objection Certificate from the forces for those still serving; dependants: certificate of death or permanent disability
Widow certificate (for age relaxation)
Married women of Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B: income certificate issued in the husband's name
All certificates must be obtained by the last date in the prescribed formats; certificates obtained after the last date, or not in the prescribed format, are not considered.
important_instructions: Wrong or false information can lead to cancellation of candidature at any time without notice and legal action. The authority is not responsible for technical problems in applying or paying the fee at the last moment. SC, ST and Category-1 certificates are valid until cancelled; Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B certificates are valid for 5 years and must be valid on the last date. Balija and its sub-castes listed in the notice must claim 3(A) reservation for employment; the 2(A) certificate obtained for education is not considered. Rural reservation applies only to candidates who studied Classes 1 to 10 in rural areas; Kannada medium reservation to those who studied Classes 1 to 10 in Kannada medium. Reservation: 4% horizontal for persons with disabilities (at least 40% disability, in categories identified for the post), 1% for third gender candidates and 2% for sportspersons from each category. Sportspersons must have lived in Karnataka for at least 10 years and may get weightage marks. Exam centre details and admit cards will be released later on the KEA website. Candidates must bring the admit card and one original photo ID (PAN card, driving licence, Aadhaar card, passport, voter ID or Government employee ID); the exam centre cannot be changed for any reason. The authority does not correspond with candidates. Any letter must give the application number and post, the full name in block letters and the postal address in the application. Updates are also posted on KEA's X account @KEA_KARNATAKA.

content_sections.heading: KEA Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: KEA Recruitment 2026 is a direct recruitment by competitive examination for Assistant Public Prosecutor-cum-Assistant Government Pleader (Group-B) posts in the Karnataka Department of Prosecutions and Government Litigations. Applications open on 18 November 2026.

rows.details: Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), Bengaluru, Government of Karnataka
Recruitment of Assistant Public Prosecutor-cum-Assistant Government Pleader (Group-B), remaining original cadre
Department of Prosecutions and Government Litigations
LLB degree with continuous practice as an advocate in civil and criminal courts in India
At least 03 years of advocate practice as on the last date for applying
Minimum 25 years; maximum 42 / 45 / 47 years by category
Preliminary: 2 objective papers (Offline-OMR); Main: 3 descriptive law papers of 100 marks each

content_sections.heading: About KEA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Examinations Authority is a Government of Karnataka body in Bengaluru that conducts this competitive examination. The posts belong to the Department of Prosecutions and Government Litigations. Post-wise and category-wise details are to be published separately as provided by the Member Secretary of the Selection Committee (Assistant Public Prosecutor-cum-Assistant Government Pleader) and the Director (in-charge) of the department.

content_sections.heading: KEA Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: KEA has notified a total of 268 Assistant Public Prosecutor-cum-Assistant Government Pleader (Group-B) posts. The 02 posts are those left out in connection with implementation of Article 371(J) of the Constitution of India. The 33 posts are backlog posts that remained unfilled in the previous recruitment. The post-wise and category-wise details will be published separately and are tentative; they may be revised from time to time as per Government orders.

content_sections.heading: KEA Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The qualification or certificate must be held as on the last date for applying. Candidates awaiting results are not eligible, and no qualification other than the one prescribed is considered. If a candidate without the prescribed qualification takes part and is later found ineligible by the authority, selection committee or appointing authority, the candidature will be cancelled at any stage. Original marks cards and certificates must be produced to the selection committee or appointing authority when called for document verification; failing this, the candidature will be cancelled. To prove the period of practice, candidates must obtain, by the last date and in the prescribed format, a certificate of practice from the competent authority along with the service certificate of their Bar Association, and produce the originals at document verification. The format is published separately. Must be a citizen of India. A man with more than one living wife, or a woman married to a man who already has a wife, is not eligible for appointment without prior permission of the Government. Must be mentally and physically healthy and free of any physical defect likely to interfere with the efficient discharge of duties; the State Government keeps full discretion to reject a candidate found unfit by a medical board. Persons permanently debarred by the Union or Karnataka or any other State Public Service Commission, the Karnataka Examinations Authority or any recruitment examination are not eligible. A person convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude, or temporarily debarred or disqualified by such bodies, is not eligible until the Government reviews the case and finds the person eligible. Candidates should check the official notification for the full wording of each eligibility condition.

rows.qualification_required: LLB degree, practising continuously as an advocate in civil and criminal courts in India under the Advocates Act, 1961, with not less than 03 years in the advocate profession as on the last date for applying.

rows.competent_authority: Hon'ble Registrar of the High Court
Hon'ble Presiding Officer of the court where the candidate practises

content_sections.heading: KEA Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed a minimum of 25 years as on the last date for applying, as per the Karnataka Prosecutions and Government Litigations (Recruitment) Rules, 2012. The maximum ages below already include a one-time relaxation of 5 years given under Government Order No. ಸಿಆಸುಇ 262 ಸೇನೆನಿ 2025 dated 29.01.2026. Under the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, the maximum age is raised as follows: Family members of persons who died or were permanently disabled in the armed forces are eligible for ex-servicemen reservation, but not for the age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: KEA Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Under the Karnataka Prosecutions and Government Litigations (Recruitment) Rules, 2012, selection has three stages: Preliminary examination – multiple-choice questions on an Offline-OMR sheet. In each paper (Paper-1 / Paper-2), SC and ST candidates need 35% and General and other categories 40%; qualifying candidates are called to the main examination in the ratio 1:10. Main examination – descriptive questions answered in writing. In each paper (Paper-1 / Paper-2 / Paper-3), SC and ST candidates need 35% and General and other categories 40%; qualifying candidates are called to the interview in the ratio 1:3. Interview – maximum 25 marks, conducted by the Selection Committee constituted under Government Order No. ಒಇ 95 ಪಿಪಿಇ 2026 dated 22.09.2026. It tests general knowledge, the ability to grasp points of law, understanding and suitability for the post. Questions may be answered in Kannada or English. A candidate absent at the interview will not be considered for selection. After the interview, a merit list is prepared on the total marks of the main examination and the interview. The Selection Committee publishes the provisional and final selection lists in the ratio 1:1 against the notified vacancies, as per the reservation rules in force. Candidates are selected following the reservation rules in the Government's orders, notifications and circulars. If two or more candidates get equal marks, the older candidate is placed higher in the merit order. Before appointment, the Department of Prosecutions and Government Litigations will verify the marks cards and certificates with the issuing departments, universities and boards, and the genuineness of the enrolment obtained from the Bar Council.

content_sections.heading: KEA Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Part-1 and Part-2 of Paper-1 are held at the same time. The OMR answer sheet has a fifth option. For a question left unanswered, the fifth option must be shaded; up to five extra minutes are given after the last bell for this. If no option, including the fifth, is shaded for a question, one-fourth (0.25) of a mark is deducted for that question. All question papers are in Kannada and English. Candidates may answer in Kannada or English, but each answer sheet must be written entirely in one language.
